digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live `undeclared` child poisons child inheritance, forcing the container to unscoped; only all live children declared `none` promote an undeclared parent to signed scope `none`.
Mixed-scope containers (live paths and none children) sign only declared child path dependencies and survive unrelated file drift.
Parent-owned paths take precedence over all-none children; explicit parent `none` remains `none`; no live children do not synthesize all-none scope.
Cheap resign (via relation_snapshot) and normal sign_plan_review must produce identical child-derived signed scope without network fetches.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advising only live undeclared children with both path and `--none` remedies.
